reviews.text:
Dr. Berke has been our Trusted Vet for 7 years now. I’m so glad I found him, and his practice. He makes you feel at ease immediately upon talking with him. He stewarded me through the passing of my Beloved 15 year old senior cat. He couldn't have been kinder, caring and knowledgeable. He clearly explains what to do in a tough pet situation, and what not to do. So there's no confusion. Which is hard when you are emotional over your pet. I also like his auto reminders for appointments. And that you can call and talk to a real Vet tech to make an appointment, or ask questions. No annoying phone tree. Just great customer service. In a clean office. Parking is easy in the lot where the business is, and it's right off the freeway. The vet techs are always so kind to my kitties.
Thanks Dr Berke - You've got a loyal customer for life!

Dr. Berk is the best Veterinarian! He's taken care of my Maltipoo for 8 years now. He saved her life from day 1 that I got her & just recently successfully surgically removed what turned out to be a benign mass in her mouth. The most important quality in Dr. Berk is not only is he very knowledgeable & helpful, but he is truly caring & loves the animals he takes great care of, along with his great staff. You can feel that he truly cares. I highly recommend him if you are looking for an excellent veterinarian.

I moved to San Diego earlier this year and did a ton of research to find the right vet for my cats. I ended up choosing this clinic, and I’m so glad I did. Dr. B is incredibly compassionate and always goes above and beyond — even helping me through email when I have concerns. I’m very pleased and highly recommend them!

Dr. Berk is one of the most attentive veterinarians I’ve ever met. He addresses every concern even before you have to ask, and instead of rushing you, he focuses on easing your worries and offering the healthiest options for your pet. His approach feels genuinely caring and reassuring.

We’ll be coming here until the day Dr. Berk retires :)
Thank you for everything!
Dr. Berk and team have been taking care of our dogs for 5 years. They have always been responsive, supportive, compassionate and professional.

Dr Burk and Dr Shatila are phenomenal. I had to put our 14.5 yrs old
German Shepherd  down July 21,2025. The compassion from them is second to none. I love these guys. They care, care, care. What more can you ask for.

Mixed review. Felt this was a great clinic but it's gone downhill. I don't feel I have been a valued patient/customer here. Records are disorganized and unreadable, staff messages slip through the cracks, and medical plans are not aggressive enough to treat dogs in a serious state. My dogs needed specialty referrals and as a dog owner I needed way more guidance than I was offered. I felt a lot of visits had little resolution to my dogs health concerns.

I’ve been a client here for many years now (>10 years) with several fur babies. I don’t live “conveniently” close anymore, but we make the drive to ensure our dogs see this special team for their medical needs. Dr. Burke and his team patient and genuinely caring at each interaction. The clinic is reasonably priced and always provides a candid assessment (clearly laying out what is required vs. highly recommended vs. generally suggested). We appreciate their continued service to the community and will proudly continue to support this business.

We’ve been bringing our dogs to this vet for almost four years. Both were neutered here and regularly visit two to three times a year for vaccines and tests. Until now, we hadn’t had any major issues.

Today, we had an appointment specifically for the rabies and parvo vaccines. After we got home, our dog vomited five times in a row. We called the clinic, and they had us come back in, where he was given two more injections to address the issue.

While on the way back, I reviewed the invoice and noticed that four vaccines had been administered, not just the two we had scheduled. When I asked why this wasn’t communicated, the response was, “Next time, clarify which vaccines you want when you check in.” I had already done that. The appointment was booked for two specific vaccines, and I clearly mentioned both at check-in.

I was then told they automatically give all due vaccines unless otherwise instructed. If that’s their policy, it was never clearly explained to me and I plan to review our past records to verify the vaccines were due. Our dog has not experienced side effects to vaccines before. It was most likely caused by soo many vaccines given at once. To top it off, we were charged $82 for the extra shots to counter the side effects caused by their lack of communication, bringing the total cost of today’s visit to over $300.

This visit left us feeling frustrated and taken advantage of. Lack of transparency, poor communication, and a refusal to take ownership of mistakes cost them our trust and our continued business.
New to the area and so glad I found this place! So down to earth, straightforward, and kind. Thanks for taking care of Ollie

Tierramesa Veterinary Clinic and Dr. Berk were a true blessing during a heartbreaking time. My beloved cat, Aslan, is now an angel, but I know he was grateful for all the care and kindness he received. Dr. Berk went above and beyond to support us, offering compassion, guidance, and comfort when we needed it most. His dedication and warmth made such a difference, and I will always appreciate everything he did for Aslan. Thank you for your kindness and for being there for us.
Dr Burk & Dr Shatila have cared for our furry children for almost 4 decades. Everyone on staff is wonderful to work with & very compassionate & caring.
The best in the west. Dr Berk is helpful and successful vet

Dr. Berk is the best vet we ever had. He really cares about the animals. He takes good care of them with compassion. He would never subject any pet to an unnecessary procedure. The clinic is well run, organized.
I gave 5 stars before. It was wrong! 10 stars ⭐️🤩🤩🤩 …
